question: Do the Experiment 17 findings hold on 400 fresh observations: three methods' picks together contain the right label, and their agreement marks a right label?
decision: What the review queue shows, and whether 'all agree' can ever assign a label automatically.
approval: Operator chose on 2026-10-12: 18 fresh test plus 19 summary; 400 observations; two AI labelling passes; Confirmatory with the plan committed before running.

H1.statement: Union of cosine, reranker and Clef picks contains the reference label for >= 85% of labelled fresh cases.

H2.statement: When all three picks agree, the agreed label is right >= 90% of the time on labelled cases.

H3.statement: First-pick accuracy per method and for a majority vote (ties to Clef), with paired sign tests.

H4.statement: 'All three agree' as an automatic rule passes Tier 2: exact one-sided 95% upper bound on wrong accepted picks <= 0.05, counting agreements on none_fit cases as wrong.

hypotheses.H0: For each hypothesis, its threshold is not met.

decision_rule.H1: Review queue shows the three methods' picks.
decision_rule.H2: Review queue marks 'all agree' picks as likely right.
decision_rule.H4: Candidate automatic rule for a later production proposal; otherwise review-first stays unchanged.

stats.paired: exact two-sided sign test on first-pick disagreements

gates.G1_integrity: input pins, GGUFs, server binary and reused runners verify before and after
gates.G2_privacy: every selected text passes the exclusion rules; injected secrets are excluded in tests
gates.G3_blindness: final reference hashed before the first model call; labeller inputs hold no model output
gates.G4_completeness: all 400 get a valid answer from each method; errors count as wrong
gates.G5_label_quality: passes 1 and 2 agree on >= 75% of the 400 before reconciliation; failure keeps running but validity becomes INCONCLUSIVE

selection.pool: entries not in the Experiment 01 ground truth (1,636)
exclude: run of 32 or more hex or base64 characters
normalised duplicate of a gallery description or an earlier selected one
selection.order: id order, then random.Random(seed).shuffle per section

labelling.answers: label id, none_fit or uncertain; none_fit may add a proposed new label name
labelling.final: agreed or conceded answer; remaining disagreement becomes disputed; uncertain and disputed are excluded from H1-H4 and reported
labelling.instruction: Pick the one label whose definition matches the observation's primary intent. Respect each definition's exclusions. Answer none_fit when no label's intent matches. Answer uncertain only when two labels fit equally.

methods.embedding: Qwen3-Embedding-4B Q8_0, Experiment 16 intent instruction, Experiment 16 runner and server port 3007
methods.cosine: 10 most similar same-section gallery observations; pick = first existing label; top three = first three distinct existing labels
methods.reranker: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B, Experiment 17 Route B, plain query, Experiment 17 runner and server port 3008
methods.clef: Experiment 15 request and server port 3005 with the batch fix; gallery examples up to 2 per label and 3 none_fit; one option order
methods.gallery: old 200 labelled cases: 60 development (AI labels) and 140 test (Experiment 10 reference)
